notes.title: July Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/b70bb130b0110e673bd391e9830a3c874188521b.png[/img]

Hey everyone! It’s time for Noobzilla’s July progress update! ^^

[h3]Pictective Characters[/h3]
Last month, we held [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/which-doma-do-129996766]a vote for the Pictective character style[/url], and the winner was the design by [url=https://x.com/uforabbitstudio]Ufo Rabbit[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/1959a657825a7717acfc5175db40f1e03b95cb8a.png[/img]

Swing by our Patreon to check out the other character designs! ^^
[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/pictective-134589091]https://www.patreon.com/posts/pictective-134589091[/url]

And dont forget to wishlist Pictective!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/


[h3]Cats Around Us: Black Cat - Community Translation Project[/h3]
Earlier this month, we reopened the community translation project for Cats Around Us, and thanks to your amazing support, Cats Around Us: Black Cat is now 100% translated into [b]17 languages[/b] as of today! Huge thanks to everyone! XD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/8fad0e654b9b17a24434de9e4f291c072b99a981.png[/img]

If your language isn’t fully translated yet and you want to jump in, feel free to drop a comment on our forum here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3426090/discussions/0/501704624676427663/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3426090/discussions/0/501704624676427663/[/url]

And dont forget to wishlist Cats Around Us: Black Cat!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/

-------------

Yup, that’s a quick update from us! ^^
Don’t forget to follow our Dev Page at https://store.steampowered.com/developer/noobzilla/, okay?

Cheers and have a great day!

UB & Estu

notes.title: May Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/2b9aabf3e3c8c4afbf03ed957467313be90b2f3c.png[/img]

Hi friends!

Can you believe we’re already in the third week of May? How’s everyone doing?
We hope you’re all doing great! :D And if things are a bit rough right now, we really hope everything gets better soon and that happiness finds its way back to you 💖

We’ve got a few updates we’d love to share with you! :D

First up, the demo for Cats Around Us is now available! ^^
It’s a short demo (because the game is short too XD), so feel free to give it a try! And if you haven’t wishlisted it yet, now’s the perfect time to hit that wishlist button :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/

---

Second, it's been 25 days since Cats and Seek: Tokyo launched!
It’s already been played by over 8,000 players and has gotten 100+ reviews with a Very Positive rating! Thank you so, so much for all the love and support 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

---

And last but not least, we gave our Noobzilla logo a little makeover!
We think it looks much cuter and more adorable now ^^ Hope you like it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f2d6b2139dfd84a99bb6cbe276ad1abd5f496352.png[/img]



That’s all for now!
Thanks a bunch for taking the time to read this little update :D
Warm hugs and have a lovely day!



– UB & Estu

P.S. Don’t forget to wishlist Pictective too, pretty please ^^ Thank you! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/

notes.title: March Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/db8e1a8ec43387abdced83c259780005b63ba803.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Time flies and here we are in March 2025! Here's a little update on what's been happening since January.

[h3]Cats and Seek: Tokyo[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/bef8f1669fd0def19386004598462647a7f53aaf.png[/img]
As of today, 4 levels are ready to play! You can explore Asakusa, Akihabara, Ueno Park, and Shibuya. Estu is currently working on the final level, making a total of 5 levels in Cats and Seek: Tokyo. One level will be available for free with all its achievements, while the other 4 will be part of the DLC for those who want extra content. The DLC is available to wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545910/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo__Extra_Content/

[h3]Cats and Seek: Toge Land[/h3]
Back in January, we collaborated with Toge Productions to release Cats and Seek: Toge Land to celebrate their anniversary. We're so happy to see that the game has received 189 reviews so far! Thank you so much to everyone who played and left a review 🥰

[h3]Prototype[/h3]
We also tested an early prototype for another game series we're working on. So far, we've received more than 60 feedback submissions through the survey included in the prototype. Thank you so much to everyone who took the time to play and share your thoughts! If you're curious and want to try it out, you can check it out on our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-prototype-120037282


[h3]Patreon[/h3]
Thank you to the 180+ members who have joined our Patreon! We've been sharing sneak peeks of upcoming levels there, and we're so grateful for your support.

We also received a suggestion from one of our players about community localization. Currently, all cat descriptions are only available in English because there are so many of them, and professional translation would be too expensive for us. Meanwhile, AI translations often produce weird or awkward phrases.

I'm now looking into ways to set up a community localization system that would be easy for everyone to use. Once I figure it out, I'll share the details on Patreon. And if you're interested in helping, please join us! [url=https://www.patreon.com/NoobzillaTeam]Our Patreon is free to join[/url].


[h3]Events[/h3]
This March, we're joining two online events: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621-South-East-Asia-Game-Aesthetic/sale/ramadanfestival2025]The Days of Ramadan[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womensdaysale]Women's Day Sale[/url]. Make sure to visit the events and check out many other awesome games! Oh, and Giant Cat is on discount too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925310/Cats_Around_Us_Giant_Cat/

[h3]Wishlist[/h3]
We're still counting on your support to wishlist our upcoming games! Your wishlist really helps us a lot. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545910/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo__Extra_Content/

That's all for now, thank you so much for being part of this journey with us! 😻

With love,
UB & Estu
